name: Mahakal II Kerr inverse004
scope: Local order-2 Kerr chart only; no direct-order comparison, full-image, movie or global continuum claims
data_source: authenticated cached reference tuples from chart003, independently checked there; not new rays

source.event_assumptions: Known shapes, centers and widths for targeted linear test; unknown amplitudes; neural field is not supplied these templates

linear_inverse.target_gram: coefficient-amplitude identity for declared unit-peak templates, not continuum L2-normalized
linear_inverse.coefficient_range: independent normal std.08 background around j=1; target amplitudes uniform[0,.7], first16 exact no-event zeros
linear_inverse.fit: unregularized full column-space pseudoinverse rcond1e-12; nuisance-projected target equivalent
outputs: bias relative to target standard error

neural_inverse.net: two hidden tanh layers width32, inputs scaled r,tbar and sin/cos of phi harmonics1..3, scalar contrast, fixed baseline1
neural_inverse.optim: 1000 Adam steps lr.002 then LBFGS100 strong_wolfe, float64 CPU1thread
neural_inverse.physics: soft source-free differential transport, not known exact dynamics for events
neural_inverse.physics_loss: 0.03*mean(Huber((j_t+Omega*j_phi)/.03), delta=1), quadratic z^2 for absz<=1 else2absz-1
neural_inverse.selection: no tuning or candidate sweep; higher quadrature same optimizer steps, not equal walltime
neural_inverse.field_metric: contrast j-1 error over 128 cached source-location samples crossed with37 observer times, chart pullback distribution only
neural_inverse.postfit_limit: relative response5e-4 AND whitened discrepancy0.1; empirical refinement not certificate

known_limitations: No Euler operator or full FNO reproduction
Known-template amplitude recovery is not arbitrary morphology
Source priors can change admissible class, not measurement rank
Independent numerical rays inherit original model and shared physics assumptions
Cached geometry already inspected, no claim of entirely fresh physics holdout
registration: Write and commit before generating new source outcomes or fitting; all source/code hashes at execution freeze; additional analyses labelled postplanned
